title: TOKEN 2049 / io.net
tagline: A technology brand translated into light, data, and motion.
location: Madinat Jumeirah, Dubai — TOKEN2049 · Singapore — SuperAI
services: Experience Design · Exhibition & Lounge Design · Art Direction · Technical Design · LED Content · Production & Delivery
concept: Create exhibition and networking environments that expressed the speed, scale, and future-facing nature of io.net's technology across two major international events.

title: Maraya Concert Series
tagline: One iconic venue. Twenty-eight distinct visual worlds.
services: Show Production · Visual Content · Lighting Design · Stage Treatments · Technical Delivery
concept:
Produce a major concert series inside Maraya, one of AlUla's most iconic venues.

Each performance needed its own visual identity while respecting the architecture, cultural setting, and character of the artist.
story:
Take Me Live developed tailored lighting, visual content, stage treatments, and 90-minute visual journeys for every show.

The creative approach changed with each artist—moving from intimate and minimal to powerful and cinematic—while preserving the integrity of Maraya's mirrored architecture.

caseStudy.response:
Take Me Live developed tailored lighting, visual content, stage treatments, and 90-minute visual journeys for every show.

caseStudy.experience:
Audiences entered a different world at every performance.

International stars and regional icons were presented through visual environments shaped around their music, identity, and the spirit of AlUla.
caseStudy.outcome:
Twenty-eight shows featuring artists including Andrea Bocelli, Mariah Carey, John Legend, Usher, Mohammed Abdo, Kadim Al Sahir, Assala Nasri, and Angham.

The series reached 2.8 million viewers globally, while hosting an intimate live audience of approximately 400 guests per evening.

title: BLACKPINK Middle East Tour
tagline: A stadium-scale production delivered across two cities.
location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia · Abu Dhabi, UAE
services: Technical Production · Vendor Management · LED · Lighting · Lasers · Special Effects · iMAG · Live Delivery
concept: Deliver the local technical production for BLACKPINK's Middle Eastern tour dates in Riyadh and Abu Dhabi, working to the precision and scale of a major international touring show.
story:
Take Me Live led local vendor and technical coordination across both cities, integrating six automated LED screens, 500 lighting fixtures, 40 lasers, and 100 special-effects units.

We also supported an 18-camera iMAG system, large-format side screens, and a synchronised pyrotechnic finale developed with the touring team.

title: Qatar Live 2021
tagline: A convention centre transformed into an immersive live arena.
services: Experiential Production · Technical Engineering · Projection Mapping · Content · Scenic Build · Live Delivery
concept:
Transform the Doha Exhibition and Convention Center into a major cultural and entertainment destination during the Arab Cup.

The environment needed to combine architecture, technology, content, and performance at an unprecedented scale.
story:
Take Me Live served as the execution partner for the complete venue transformation, delivered over twenty days.

At its centre was The Flower—a projection-mapped structure built from 92 petals and suspended through 482 rigging points. To overcome the venue's structural limitations, our team engineered a bespoke ground-support system.

title: Lusail Super Cup
tagline: A stadium debut told through culture, light, music, and collective energy.
client: FIFA & Supreme Committee for Delivery & Legacy
services: Stadium-Scale Production · Stage Engineering · Lighting · Audience Technology · Pyrotechnics · Broadcast Coordination · Live Delivery
concept:
Help launch Lusail Stadium through a major pre-World Cup moment that brought football, entertainment, and regional culture together.

The production needed to reflect the stadium's architecture and Arab visual heritage while performing at global broadcast scale.
story:
Take Me Live engineered key production elements across the stadium, including the circular performance stage, stadium-wide lighting, audience technology, camera blocking, and pyrotechnic coordination.

Every cue was precision-timed around Amr Diab's headline performance and the live broadcast.

caseStudy.response:
Take Me Live engineered key production elements across the stadium, including the circular performance stage, stadium-wide lighting, audience technology, camera blocking, and pyrotechnic coordination.

Every cue was precision-timed around Amr Diab's headline performance and the live broadcast.
caseStudy.experience:
The stadium became one connected visual environment through lighting, music, fireworks, content, and 80,000 synchronised LED wristbands.

More than a football match, the night became a shared cultural spectacle for the entire audience.

title: Cinema Medley
tagline: Film music transformed into a live visual and symphonic experience.
services: Stage Design · Technical Production · Lighting · Audio · Visual Content · Live Delivery
concept:
Bring Imperial Orchestra's Middle East debut to life through a production that matched the scale, emotion, and cinematic power of its programme.

The stage needed to support a full orchestra, choir, specialist instruments, and large-format visual storytelling.
story:
Take Me Live delivered the stage and technical production across two performances—Cinema Medley in May and the larger Cinema Medley 2 in December.

Lighting, audio, visual content, and stagecraft were designed to move in perfect sync with the orchestra and give every soundtrack its own atmosphere.

Audiences experienced iconic film scores through a blend of live music, cinematic imagery, and immersive lighting.
